capabilities: render lyrics from LRC and SRT subtitle code blocks
sync lyric highlighting with audio playback
navigate the audio player by clicking lyrics
control playback via a context menu (play/pause, seek, auto-scroll)
style lyrics with provided CSS classes
extras: The README says it 'enhances your audio player', implying it depends on a separate audio player plugin; no screenshots or limitations are documented.
problem: Obsidian's audio playback offers no way to follow or navigate audio through synced lyric or subtitle text.
summary: Renders interactive lyrics from LRC/SRT subtitles in lrc code blocks, synced with an audio player for navigating playback.
